args.title: Update error message for column mismatch in src/i18n/en.json
args.body: This pull request addresses the error message that displays when an upload fails due to a column mismatch. The error currently states: 'Malformed row: the number of columns does not match the header'. This message is unhelpful and needs clarification for the end user. The proposed change aims to improve user comprehension by providing a more detailed explanation of what is expected for successful uploads.
